name: Kaede Tsukimura
want: prove she can make it in the city, and find a way to help the family inn
voice: Polite with a country lilt that slips out when she is excited.
description: The daughter of Tsukimura-ya, a small family inn in Fukuroda Onsen, two hours north in Daigo. First of her family to go to high school away from home; lives in the Seiryo dorm.
appearance: Long dark hair in a low ponytail, sensible shoes, a charm from the Fukuroda shrine on her school bag.
